provenance.regen: v0's recipe ('replace each C with its .hex() form') was itself buggy — it base64-decoded the hex string first. To build a clean wrong-encoding probe, replace each C with a deliberately non-point string of the same length class (e.g. 66 'a' chars) and re-encode.
